entries.89739691b88e5a96: It sets as its goal creating unique value and bringing smiles to people around the world through entertainment that inspires surprise and emotion. To achieve this, it focuses on improving existing technologies and on research and development of new technologies, and its policy is to collaborate with companies that have strengths in sales and development overseas. As issues to address, it cites acquiring new clients, including overseas sales, and strengthening relationships with existing clients in commissioned development, and thorough outsourcing management and quality control in the amusement machine field, and states that it aims to create synergies across the group through collaboration using the IP held by Aquaplus Co., Ltd., which it made a wholly owned subsidiary.
